messages:
maya: Quick econ snapshot from nova-9b quant runs this morning. Short score + recs below.
ryan: drop the headline numbers pls.
maya: headline: int8 looks like the best baseline tradeoff; int4 yields bigger savings but introduces measurable slice regressions (legal, longform QA). Table: float16 baseline p95=230ms quality=100.0 cost/1M=$2600; int8 p95=200ms quality=99.4 cost/1M=$1750; int4 p95=170ms quality=97.2 cost/1M=$1300; hybrid routing (short=int4,long=int8) p95=175ms quality=98.9 cost/1M~$1350.
anika: how confident on those slice hits for int4?
maya: we ran 5k canonical + 500 per sensitive slice. int4 failed 3/12 legal prompts with hallucination artifacts; longform QA EM dropped ~5 points on a medical subset.
lina: product constraint: GTN default must be within 1% quality and low-risk on trust slices.
ryan: infra note: int4 reduced KV cache capacity ~40% which increased miss rate on multi-turn tests; p99 tail variance up ~8%.
anika: recommendation?
maya: recommend: 1) Default GTN to int8 quant (best cost-quality balance). 2) Enable "sensitivity routing" so flows tagged as legal/medical/finance go to int8/float path only. 3) Offer hybrid routing for opt-in low-sensitivity, latency-critical paths. 4) Canary plan: 5% traffic x 48h with these gates: overall eval delta >1.0% OR any sensitive slice delta >2.0% OR user-feedback spike >40% -> rollback. Infra gates: p95 increase >15% or error rate +0.5% abs -> rollback.
lina: sales wants unit-econ line for decks.
maya: unit-econ quick: savings per 1M tokens = float16->int8 $850, float16->int4 $1,300. At 100M tokens/month -> int8 ~$85k/mo saved, int4 ~$130k/mo (but with risk on trust slices).
ryan: ops: set dashboards for KV cache miss rate, p95/p99 histograms, slice-level quality, and a small user-feedback counter.
anika: please paste the command to reproduce the sweep so solutions can validate.
maya: paste: ```bash
./run_quant_sweep --model nova-9b --modes float16,int8,int4 --slices canonical,legal,medical,longform --out /artifacts/nova9b-quant-1742202468
```
devops-bot: Canary deploy queued: ryan scheduled canary at 1742203600. Monitor #eng-oncall. :robot_face:
lina: can someone draft a 2-line rec for GTN signoff?
anika: draft: "Set GTN default to int8 quant for now (≈-0.6% quality, ~33% token-cost reduction). Block int4 on tagged sensitive slices and roll out hybrid routing for non-sensitive latency-critical paths behind a 5% x 48h canary with quality and infra gates."
ryan: +ops note: increase eviction thresholds and add temporary cache warmup to avoid cold churn during canary.
maya: I'll upload failure examples and slice artefacts to the artifact path and tag them in the scorecard.
lina: thanks all. approving canary once artifacts are uploaded.
ryan: on it.
